name: idwt2
expr: X = idwt2(cA, cH, cV, cD, 'haar'); Xs = idwt2(single(cA), single(cH), single(cV), single(cD), 'haar'); Xmix = idwt2(cA, single(cH), cV, cD, 'haar'); Xlg = idwt2(logical(cA), logical(cH), logical(cV), logical(cD), 'haar'); Xcx = idwt2(complex(cA,1), cH, cV, cD, 'haar'); Xsx = idwt2(cA, cH, cV, cD, 'haar', [2 3]); sgl_ok = double(abs(double(Xs(1,1)) - X(1,1)) < 1e-5); [sA,sH,sV,sD] = dwt2([1 2 3;4 5 6;7 8 9],'haar'); Xsf = idwt2(sA,sH,sV,sD,'db4');
comment: Sig X=idwt2(cA,cH,cV,cD,wname): single-level 2-D inverse Haar DWT, 2x2 subbands -> 4x4. Distinct nonzero detail coeffs: X(1,1)=1.3, X(2,2)=-0.2, X(4,4)=1.825, X(1,3)=0.85, sum(X)=20. Pins the per-quadrant reconstruction (not just a round-trip identity). Argcheck portion 2026-09-19: every numeric class accepted (logical/integer compute in double); single anywhere = single result; complex coefficients = complex result (linear real/imag split through the kernel - imag(cA)=1 reconstructs a constant +0.5i offset, probed); SIZ = central crop of the natural reconstruction (not a target size). Known open bug: filter longer than the coefficients supports returns empty (bugs/opened/wavelet/idwt-short-filter-input.md). The all-single path is compared through a 1e-5 closeness predicate: the reference computes single in single arithmetic end-to-end while nk computes in double and casts (values agree to ~1e-7, shapes/classes exact - battery-verified at 6 digits). 2026-09-18 short-filter: haar coeffs (2x2) + db4 → 10x10 natural reconstruction (wkeep1 uncropped rule; the bug file's first 4x4 claim was a battery misread).
